diagnosis.what_happened: Raw markdown syntax was dumped into DOCX files, edits between MD and DOCX drifted asymmetrically, and minimal stubs were used for introduction and summary sections.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Asymmetrical editing broke the Triad Invariant, native formatting constraints were violated via markdown string dumping, and doctoral depth was compromised by short stubs.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: DOCX deliverables must be compiled from the MD source of truth using a robust Markdown to OpenXML AST compiler. Introductions and summaries must reflect extensive institutional depth.
diagnosis.rationale_why: To rigorously uphold the Triad Invariant, formatting integrity, and Directive 25 (Universal Anti-Shortcut, Zero-Fastpath, No-Rush).

desired_behavior: Mandate robust markdown-to-OpenXML parser compiling strictly from MD source of truth, and ensure doctoral-level depth for introductions and summaries.
generalization: Deliverable formatting and content depth must strictly adhere to native compiling practices and zero-shortcut institutional standards across all projects.

evidence.observed_value: Markdown syntax in DOCX and stubs
